description: Show your support for firefighters and first responders with Rothco's Thin Red Line Concealed Carry Shoulder Bag. Designed with both functionality and durability in mind, this versatile CCW shoulder bag is made from rugged 600D polyester with strong polypropylene webbing, ensuring it can withstand the demands of daily use. The tactical bag features a spacious main compartment, a large side pouch with a flap and quick-release buckles, and a side zippered pouch with exterior MOLLE attachments for additional gear. The front of the bag includes 3 zippered pouches for easy access to smaller items. For added security, the rear zippered pocket is equipped with a loop field for a hook & loop concealed carry attachment, providing a discreet and secure storage option. The tactical CCW bag also offers multiple carrying options with a top carry handle and an adjustable/removable shoulder strap. Supporting a noble cause, proceeds from this purchase benefit families of fallen first responders, making this bag both a practical and meaningful accessory.
